capabilities: expand dates from natural language via editor autosuggest
parse selected text into dates, times, links, or plain text
open daily notes through an obsidian://nldates URI
pick dates from a date picker command
extras: Documents a developer API (parsedDate() and moment token reference) so other plugins can reuse its parser; hotkeys are unset by default since v0.4.1.
problem: Obsidian requires typing dates in exact formats; writing relative expressions like 'last Friday' or '5 days ago' gives nothing usable.
summary: Natural language date parser that expands phrases like @today or '2 weeks from now' into date links, timestamps, and daily-note links.
